limitations: The global account directory is mutable and not pinned to a block hash.
The fixture proves one nonempty descending page and continuation cursor, not a complete directory snapshot.
The live response reports createdAt as RFC 3339 text although the OpenAPI example shows Unix milliseconds.
The live response reports null status values, so absent status remains uninterpreted.
Directory membership does not prove present control of an owner or subaccount key.
